interactive.label: Help
interactive.tooltip: Explain what drift correction measures, which settings decide the answer and what to check.

interactive.label: Guide
interactive.tooltip: Walk through the tool step by step; each step waits for you to use the control it points at.

interactive.label: Measure
interactive.tooltip: Measure the inter-frame drift of the selected channel. Choosing a file measures it at once; press this after changing the reference, the estimator or the channel.

interactive.label: Export stack
interactive.tooltip: Write the drift-corrected stack as a multi-page TIFF (every channel is corrected with the shift measured on one).

interactive.label: Export shifts
interactive.tooltip: Write the per-frame displacements to a CSV file.

interactive.label: filename
interactive.tooltip: The stack to correct: a TIFF stack, or a photon-stream file (PTU/HT3/…) reconstructed into a confocal-scan image. Photon streams are corrected photon by photon, so the result stays usable for lifetime and correlation analysis.

interactive.label: Browse
interactive.tooltip: Browse for an image stack or photon-stream file on disk.

interactive.label: Database
interactive.tooltip: Load a dataset registered in the database; the database resolves it to a local file wherever its object store keeps the data.
